evals.name: dry-runs the fan-out before executing
evals.prompt: I have twelve monthly order exports, orders_2025_01.csv through orders_2025_12.csv. Run the same cleaning pipeline we used on the sample across all of them.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the pipeline on one input, previews the generated commands, then fans out with a job log and reconciles the counts.
assertions: The response previews or dry-runs the generated commands before executing them across all inputs.
The response verifies the pipeline on a single input first.
The response reconciles output count against input count afterwards.
